sources.note: Nothing. Sole Tebul mention is p. 256 (pdf p. 236): Blench (2005) encountered a small number of deaf signers in a Tebul Ure speaking hamlet in Koro, recorded sample sentences and narratives; Ethnologue lists it as [tsy]. Chapter is a sociolinguistic survey of Douentza signers; no prosody/stress content anywhere ('stress'/'prosod' a full-text search for stress/accent over the whole volume hits only unrelated chapters).
